installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OTR-OBIA pipeline - installation script
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e

# Avoid an apt/debconf prompt (e.g. tzdata) hanging forever with no TTY to answer it.
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export TZ=Etc/UTC

apt update -y
apt install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git curl ca-certificates \
    build-essential python3-dev \
    gdal-bin libgdal-dev libgeos-dev libproj-dev libexpat1

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
    GIT_BRANCH="main"
fi

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Repo already present, pulling latest ${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git fetch origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git pull origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
else
    echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPOSITORY} (${GIT_BRANCH})"
    git clone --single-branch --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPOSITORY}" .
fi

export HOME=/mnt/server

echo "Creating virtual environment"
python3 -m venv venv
. venv/bin/activate

pip install --upgrade pip
if [ -f "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}" ]; then
    pip install -r "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
fi

echo "Install complete."
exit 0

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Pull the latest commit and reinstall requirements.txt every time the server (re)starts.

0 = false (default), 1 = true

variables.name: Requirements File
variables.description: Path (relative to the repo root) of the pip requirements file to install.
